subject: economics
title: Unemployment and Inflation
welcome_lead: Two big macro problems - and how to spot each type.
meta_desc: A-Level Macroeconomics: types of unemployment and inflation.
final_note: Policy must match the cause - demand-side or supply-side.

concepts.def: Mismatch between skills and jobs available.
Caused by downturns in aggregate demand.
Consumer Prices Index - basket of consumer goods.
Retail Prices Index - older UK measure, includes housing.

walkthroughs.body_html: Frictional unemployment is benign; structural needs retraining; cyclical needs demand stimulus. Mistaking the type wastes policy effort.
CPI uses a basket of consumer goods. RPI includes housing costs and tends to be higher. Both miss housing price inflation in the same way.
Demand-pull inflation comes from excess AD; cost-push inflation from rising input costs (oil, wages). The response differs - tighten policy vs supply-side reforms.
